policy.ownership: The source project owns the handoff semantics. The target project keeps ownership of its own content, evidence and interpretation.
policy.displayRule: Render only curated relations that provide a materially different next step for the user.
policy.evidenceBoundary: A linked concept reference may explain a mechanism or decision pattern. It does not validate the Brali protocol, its efficacy, or inherited quantitative claims.
policy.seoBoundary: Do not generate site-wide project lists, keyword-driven relations, reciprocal links, or links whose primary purpose is search ranking.
